requirement: Security operators shall be able to initiate scans of local container images and running containers from the command line and receive completion or failure status together with any generated scan results.
Operators shall be able to run multiple supported scanning tools in independent Docker container environments using veinmind-runner and initiate local image scans through a quick-start workflow.

For Docker authorization integration, the suite shall classify requests into plugin actions using configured rules that match the request method and URI. It shall select the first matching action encountered and return the designated fallback action when no rule matches.

Users shall be able to scan Infrastructure as Code files against policy libraries and receive structured alerts for detected risks. The scanner shall merge duplicate result groups and publish alerts containing the applicable rule, severity, remediation information, and affected file locations.

Malicious-file scan reports shall summarize scanned image and file counts, malicious-file counts, scan start time, and elapsed time. Findings shall identify the affected image, layer, and file, include file paths, hashes, and descriptions, and preserve the relationships between images, layers, and findings.
Plugin developers shall be able to add scanning logic using veinmind-sdk/libveinmind and expose it through mapped scan commands while reusing the existing runner workflow.
The suite shall support integration with DockerHub, Docker Registry, and Harbor image registries and with Docker and Containerd container runtimes.
